boardTokens.title: Job boards (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable or Personio)
boardTokens.description: Companies to read. Greenhouse: a board token (the part after boards.greenhouse.io/, for example "airbnb") or any Greenhouse job board URL. Lever: "lever:<company>" (for example "lever:zoox") or any jobs.lever.co URL; use "lever-eu:<company>" or a jobs.eu.lever.co URL for EU-hosted boards. Ashby: "ashby:<company>" (for example "ashby:ramp") or any jobs.ashbyhq.com URL. Workable: "workable:<account>" (for example "workable:blueground") or any apply.workable.com URL. Personio: "personio:<company>" (for example "personio:tado") or any jobs.personio.com or jobs.personio.de URL. Put one board per line (several on a line, separated by commas, also work). Each board is one request.

searchAllCompanies.title: Search all companies (no company names needed)
searchAllCompanies.description: Ignore "Job boards" and search the Actor's directory of company boards with your title and location keywords; at least one keyword is required. Boards with a matching job are read live. The directory is refreshed daily, so a job posted today can be missing until tomorrow. Each job returned is one result, as usual.

includeContent.title: Include full job descriptions
includeContent.description: Return each job's description (HTML and plain text) with its departments and offices. Turn off for a lighter list of titles, locations and links only.

titleKeywords.title: Title keywords
titleKeywords.description: Keep only jobs whose title contains at least one of these words (not case-sensitive). Leave empty for every job.

locationKeywords.title: Location keywords
locationKeywords.description: Keep only jobs whose location or office contains at least one of these words, for example "Remote" or "London" (not case-sensitive). Leave empty for every location.

onlyNew.title: Only new jobs
onlyNew.description: Return, and charge for, only jobs that earlier runs with the same boards and keywords have not returned yet. Turn it on and schedule the Actor (for example daily) to get a feed of newly posted jobs; a run with no new jobs charges no results. The first run returns every open job.

reportRemoved.title: Report removed jobs
reportRemoved.description: Also return the jobs that earlier runs with the same boards and keywords returned and that are no longer listed: filled, closed or taken down. Each comes once, marked change "removed", with its title, company, location and link, and counts as one result. Every job is marked "new" or "open" too. A board that fails to load in a run keeps its jobs, so it never reports false closures.

monitorName.title: Monitor name
monitorName.description: Optional, for "Only new jobs". Runs with the same name share one memory of returned jobs, even when you add or remove boards. Without a name, the memory follows the boards and keywords.

maxResults.title: Maximum results
maxResults.description: Stop after this many jobs. Each job is charged once.

maxRequestsPerSecond.title: Maximum requests per second
maxRequestsPerSecond.description: Polite rate limit for the job board APIs. At most 1 request per second, which is what Lever's robots.txt asks for; the Actor also honours Retry-After and backs off on errors.
